name: flighty-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to the Flighty flight tracking app. View flights, check statuses, get delay forecasts, see travel stats, and add or remove flights — all synced to your devices.

read_only.title: Read-Only Mode
read_only.description: Disable the add/follow/remove flight tools. Claude can still read your flight data but cannot modify your Flighty account. Recommended if you only want travel context in AI conversations.
